I rewrote two parts of the chat-v2 `requirements.md` and logged a "rewrote" line in `flags.jsonl`. I didn't shoot any pages or read `text-check.mjs`'s source.

- **Shown, not told:** I added a small tree of the nested chat. A Prompt sits at the root, with the 🧠 replies, questions and task cards beneath it.
- **Checklist:** "Done when" is now a checklist of steps 1–3, the owner-visible result, and the two readmes.

The only `text-check.mjs` flag was `past-work.md` at 816 words. That file is generated by `Server/PastWork.mjs`, so I left it alone.

Chat v2 step 1, the read-only renderer, is built and committed as `5e3ff2a46` on `worktree/chat-v2`. I have not merged it; the parent reviews and merges.

**What's built** (in `public/framework/ext/Chat/v2/`):
- **Renderer:** `ChatV2.js` is `class ChatV2 extends JSONL` and `ChatV2Model.js` folds the lines. Each Prompt draws at the chat root, with no bubble and no card. It shows the refined text, or its sentences when there is no refined text.
- **Nesting:** replies, questions and child tasks sit under their prompt, marked 🧠, in file order with nothing sorted. A root Question with `from` also nests under its prompt.
- **Raw text:** "show raw" reveals the raw Whisper lines and the cleaned paragraphs. It stays open when a live append redraws the chat.
- **Anchored replies:** a reply tied to a sentence and a word range marks those words. It sits beside its sentence when sentences are visible and below it on a phone.
- **Styles, fixture and page:** `ChatV2.css` has every rule in `@layer` with `chat-v2-` classes. `fixture/session.jsonl` is the sample. `page.js` is the demo at `/framework/ext/Chat/v2/`, and `?src=` points it at another file.
- **Docs:** `readme.md` is new, with one link line added to `ext/Chat/readme.md`. The old chat is untouched.

**Test:** `ChatV2.test.mjs` passes 19 of 19. It covers order, nesting, the question and task phases, show raw, and live append without a reload. `node --check` passes on every JS file. `node Server/smoke.mjs` shows no FAIL on `/framework/ext/Chat/v2/`.

**Shots:** both are in `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/sessions-and-tasks/dictation-debug/chat-v2/renderer/shots/`.
- `chat-v2-1920.png`
- `chat-v2-390.png`

**Decisions:**
- **Plain fold instead of `Session.replay`:** `Item.hydrate` drops the raw Whisper strings, so the model folds the lines itself. `ChatV2Model.js` is the one file to swap when the real `core/Task/Prompt.js` and `Question.js` land.
- **Own child card instead of `TaskView.row`:** the card carries the phase data the test checks. It reuses `TaskView.STAGE` for task icons.
- **Anchored replies drawn once:** beside the sentence when sentences are visible, otherwise in the nest with a quote chip.

No existing readme or doc is out of date. No skill misled me. Nothing writes this data into a session yet; the readme says so. The logging and finish line are in my `renderer/session.jsonl`.

The `writers/requirements.md` proposal is clear, and I logged one "clear" line in `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`. `node Server/text-check.mjs` returned no flags, and I made no rewrites.

I didn't open a screenshot, since the proposal is a `.md` file with no page.

I wrote `review.md` with verdict `fix`. I read the diff and spot-checked the surrounding code, but I didn't run the page or look at any screenshots.

The diff does what `requirements.md` asks. It adds the two chips, mounts v2 lazily, keeps `?chat_view=v2` on reload, and unsubscribes in `deactivated()`. v1 stays the default, the `chat_ok` rule is untouched, and the edits stay inside the Chat panel. I found nothing broken in the code and no simpler way.

The two `[fix]` findings:
- **Stale readme:** `ext/Chat/v2/readme.md` still says "Not wired yet" and only points to the standalone page. It should say v2 is now embedded in the session page's Chat tab and that `?chat_view=v2` opens it.
- **No proof in the task folder:** the claimed check (557 items drawn at 400 and 1200, switching back hides v2) has no screenshots or output beside `requirements.md`. A fresh agent can't confirm it without redoing the run.

I added three `[note]` findings, none blocking: no cleanup problem found on quick re-activation, the v1 boxes are only wrapped so the code that fills them is unchanged, and `choose` rewrites the URL on first build even when nothing changed.

Work is committed on `worktree/chat-v2-writers` at `53cbf7374`. Summary for the parent:

**What writes what**
- **Fast seat** (`Servex/agents/Sessions.js`, `voice_say`): writes one `Prompt` task per call — via the new `Servex/agents/PromptLines.js` (one pure function per line shape) — through the session's existing single writer (`this.write`). One `voice_say` call already represents one coherent thought (a lone `say()` line or a whole `release_thought()` batch), so this is "one Prompt per idea" without new judgment logic.
- **Smart seat** (`Servex/agents/session-smart.md`, new "Chat v2" section): writes the refined title/text, replies (optionally anchored to a sentence), Questions, and answers — all through the `item` tool directly (it's an LLM, not code), with one example of each line.
- **Page reports** (`Servex/Servex.js`'s `/api/voice` route, now takes `kind`, default `speech` unchanged): `error` → a `log` line on the voice session; `click`/`context` → queued onto the smart seat's `notes` for its next turn. `public/framework/ext/Chat/v2/report.js` (new) posts `window.onerror`/`unhandledrejection` as `error`, plus opt-in `click()`/`context()` — not wired into any page yet (`ux/Dictate` is another agent's fence).

**Look-first finding (logged in `plan.md` and `session.jsonl`):** voice sessions never reach `session.jsonl` as Prompts through `PromptsToSession.mjs`/`PromptRecords.mjs` — those only mirror a VS Code tab's `prompts.jsonl` (`PromptTasks.record_for()` gates on `kind === "vscode-tab"`). So this is a first writer, not a second Prompt for one utterance.

**Decision with alternative:** the brief's `/api/voice` (Servex.js:812) actually belongs to a different system (`VoicePage`, the Live-Refine demo, keyed by a transcript uuid) — not the real speech path. Extended that exact route anyway (fence names it; `kind:"speech"` behavior is byte-for-byte unchanged) rather than adding a new route, which the fence doesn't allow.

**Test:** `node Servex/agents/PromptLines.test.mjs` — 8/8 pass, folds a temp `session.jsonl` with the real `ChatV2Model.js`. `node Server/smoke.mjs` against the worktree — no FAIL.

**Restart:** Servex must restart to pick up `Sessions.js`/`Servex.js`/`PromptLines.js` (dev-server-only code). `session-smart.md` takes effect once a smart seat is next spawned.

Not merging — leaving that to you per the brief.

## Chat v2: update in place, never redraw — committed

**Commit:** `1511646de` on `worktree/chat-v2` (after merging `michael/dev` to pick up `core/Task/Prompt.js`/`Question.js`).

**What changed:**
- `ChatV2Model.apply(line)` now returns what a line touched — `{id, parent, added}` for a new node (parent `null` at the root), or `{id, added:false}` for a field change on an id already drawn.
- `ChatV2` keeps one `View` per item id, plus three persistent containers per prompt (`head`, `raw`, `nest`). A new line either appends one element where it belongs (`$box`, a prompt's `nest`, or beside its sentence) or calls `view.empty(bodyFn)` to refill just that one element's content — its `.el` never changes, so everything untouched (siblings, the parent's other children, every other prompt, scroll position) stays exactly as it was.
- Matched `ChatV2Model`'s field reads to the real `Prompt`/`Question` classes that landed since the brief was written: `title` reads `title ?? subject` (`Prompt.label`'s order), an anchor accepts `{from,to}` as well as `{words}`, an answer's time reads `at ?? ts`, `phase` already matched `Question.phase`.
- Readme Decisions updated: plain-fold-vs-classes (still fold, now that classes exist), and the new in-place-vs-keyed-diff decision with its alternative.

**Test:** grew from 19 → **38 passing checks** — 2 for the new fixture shapes (subject-as-title, `{from,to}` anchor), 7 for in-place updates (paragraph append, reply add, child state change, question answer, title set, new child task, new root prompt), each asserting every untouched element keeps its exact DOM object and the scroll position holds. Also fixed the test's direct `chromium.launch()` to go through `Server/Browser.mjs` (the ledger hook flagged it).

**Smoke:** `node Server/smoke.mjs` on `/framework/ext/Chat/v2/` — no FAIL.

Not merged — leaving that to `mastermind-chat-v2`.

## Status: wrapping up (budget near limit, $3.26/$5)

**Current state on `worktree/chat-v2`, HEAD `b70aab982`:** the in-place update work is done and landed, including fixes other agents applied in response to `reviewer-in-place`'s findings while I was working:
- **Stale nest on "show raw"/title flip** — fixed (`a26d9b182`'s `move_anchored`: only the anchored replies move between the sentence rows and the nest, never the Task/Question children).
- **Stray review index** — fixed (`b70aab982`).
- Readme and test count are in sync (**43 checks**).

**What I verified just now:**
- `node --check` clean on `ChatV2.js`, `ChatV2Model.js`, `ChatV2.test.mjs`.
- Ran the test suite 7 times: 6/7 clean at 43/43 passed. One run showed transient failures while another agent was mid-edit on the same files on disk; not reproducible once things settled — environment flakiness from concurrent edits, not a logic bug, so no code change was needed.

**Not chased further** (budget): the review's remaining notes (shots at the wrong path, a field read not going through the Model, the brief's weak fixture case) are cosmetic/pre-existing and not blocking — flagging them for `mastermind-chat-v2` rather than spending more here.

Handing back to `mastermind-chat-v2` for merge review.

Round 2 is committed and logged. Summary for the parent:

**What writes what now**
- A **Prompt starts on the first `say()` line of a thought**, any seat (`Sessions.js`'s `assign_prompt`, called unconditionally from `say()`), id kept on `s.prompt`. Every later line of the same thought pushes raw words and grows paragraph "a" live, as it's said. `s.prompt` clears the moment the thought is handed to a seat (`release_thought`, or a standalone line) — a fallback respawn never writes a second Prompt, since it only ever calls `voice_say`/`send` directly, never `say()`.
- **Both seats are told the Prompt id**: every message to fast or smart gets a trailing `(prompt p-<ms>)` line (`voice_say`, `release_thought`, `feed_smart`). `session-smart.md` tells the smart seat to read it from there.
- **`kind` moved off `/api/voice`** (fully reverted — that route belongs to the Live-Refine demo) **onto the real speech path**, `Sessions.js`'s `say()` / `POST /api/session/say`. Validates `session` as `Object.hasOwn(this.map, …)`, text, and kind; a non-speech call returns before touching any seat or Prompt. `report.js` now posts to `servex_url("/api/session/say")`.
- Readme's Decisions now names every choice with its alternative; merged cleanly with another agent's own new entries there (one conflict, additive, resolved).

**Commits:** `def7023a9` (the 7 fixes + stub test), `b03bd6345` (dev-server file-index bookkeeping, committed before merging per the brief), `cf587b365` (merge `michael/dev`, one readme conflict resolved).

**Tests:** `PromptLines.test.mjs` 8/8, new `PromptLines.say.test.mjs` (stub Sessions, no SDK/Servex) 4/4 — proves one Prompt per thought, the seat message carries the id, the respawn adds no Prompt, and `kind:"error"` becomes a log line that never reaches a seat. `node Server/smoke.mjs` against the worktree: no FAIL, before and after the merge.

**Review:** all 11 findings (7 fix, 4 note) answered in `session.jsonl`.

**Restart:** Servex must restart to pick up `Sessions.js`/`Servex.js`/`PromptLines.js`. Not merging — leaving that to you.

Done and idle — round 2 of chat-v2-writers landed (commit `cf587b365`, merged with `michael/dev`), all 11 review findings answered in `session.jsonl`, tests passing (8/8 + 4/4), smoke clean. Reported back to `mastermind-chat-v2` and awaiting their merge decision; no further action pending on my end.

I reviewed the diff and wrote the report to `chat-v2/review.md` with verdict `pass`. It has four findings, all `[note]`, and I made no code edits.

The real change is small: `ChatV2.test.mjs` plus one `.gitignore` line. The test's live copy is now a per-run `live-<pid>.jsonl`, written into the tree the site serves. That stops a worktree run from failing to find the copy. The logic reads correct to me, and the file is still deleted at the end of a run. I did not run the test.

- **Noise in the diff:** about 25 other files are `files.jsonl` machine-state lines from unrelated modules. They are not part of the fix.
- **Readme gap:** the module readme at `ext/Chat/v2/readme.md` does not mention the per-run `live-*` file or that the test writes into the main tree when run from a worktree.
- **Requirements:** this is a test-harness fix for step 1's proof, so no ask in `requirements.md` is newly met or broken. `mkdirSync` imported at `ChatV2.test.mjs:3` may now be unused.
